sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    f=current_frame; rows=f.ascii.split('\n')
    y=sum(1 for r in range(64) if rows[r][63]=='Y')
    ys=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>15 and min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])<60:
            ys.append((n['pixels'],min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])))
    return f.step, y, sorted(ys)
print("before:",state())
action(['UP'])
print("after UP:",state(), last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('done'))
action(['ACTION7'])
print("after ACTION7:",state(), last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('done'), last_action_result.get('game_over'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
